summary: Restored proposal, functionality, canonical/rendered owned source and all targeted registry, appearance-helper and reset-wrapper evidence into this attempt. All six changes supported; all upstream contradictions reconciled, with compiled-layout claims explicitly deferred. Supported retained knowledge and rendered air-entry name remain unchanged.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical registry binds the spawn callback to Moltres. The spawn body clears facing and command variable 0, invokes air initialization, and passes attribute x0 to shared setup.
Registry identity and the explicit state-1 entry support the Moltres mapping, not Entei or repeated-hit Fire Spin behavior.
State-2 collision only returns false; the neighboring animation callback tests the strict top boundary. General collision or damage immunity does not follow.
The canonical body confirms effect 0x464, scale 1.1f, reset-wrapper call, x4 velocity assignment, state 1 with argument 2, hitlag callbacks, and final flag write in the stated order.
The shared appearance helper gates the transition; the reset wrapper delegates to itResetVelocity, and the local inline performs state entry rather than continuing physics.

The helper calls common processing before testing the timer, restores scale on an already-nonpositive timer, and otherwise decrements then returns false. The proposed explanation preserves these false-path effects and transition ordering.

contradictions.reason: Accept the three mapping supersessions and all six Entei-link rejections: the canonical registry explicitly binds this table and spawn/event callbacks to Fire (Moltres), with a separate Entei registration.
Accept correction of the broad collision-insensitivity claim: the inert terrain callback establishes no general immunity.
Accept the data-flow and purpose supersessions: the inline requests motion state 1 and installs hitlag callbacks, rather than performing an ongoing physics update.
Accept the false-path supersession: evaluation of the guard itself performs shared processing and timer mutation even when the local transition is skipped.

Accept deferral of the state-table compiled-size fact, literal-pool fact, and both .sdata2 membership links. Source establishes three initializers and literal consumers, not compiled sizes, placement, membership, or ordering.
